test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Intense
solution:
The correct answer is **Faint**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's see the meaning of both the given words:

__
 
• **Intense -** extreme and forceful or (of a feeling) very strong

 
 
• 
 
***Eg***. He suddenly felt an intense pain in his back.

 
 
 
 
• Faint.- not strong or clear; slight
 
 
• ***Eg***. She gave me a faint smile of recognition​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here will see the meaning of some other given synonyms:

 
• **Regular- **happening or doing something often

 
 
• ***Eg***. She goes to her doctor for* regular* check-ups.
 
 
 
• **Rough- **not even or smooth, often because of being in bad condition
 
 
• ***Eg.*** It was a *rough *mountain road, full of stones and huge holes.
 
 
 
• **Stationary- **not moving, or not changing
 
 
• ***Eg.*** The traffic got slower and slower until it was* stationary.*
